payload.title: Production Intern
payload.description:
At Home, we're looking for a Production Assistant Intern to join our team. Briefly, we're seeking a dedicated individual capable of supporting our production team in executing high-quality projects by performing a variety of duties such as arranging and collecting props, cast, finding locations, and working on set with a filming crew as supporting staff for various tasks.

About us.

Home is a mission-driven, social-first creative agency. We support brands such as Zalando, HelloFresh, and the Rookvrije Generatie with campaigns and content. While doing so, we strive to achieve our mission of creating a more inclusive tomorrow. This is because we believe that a more inclusive society is not only a better place for all but also an effective business strategy for brands, as inclusivity helps attract a wider audience.

Home takes a community-first approach to communication. In our way of working, we focus on what connects relevant communities and explore how we can make brands meaningful within these communities.

About the internship.

As a Production Assistant Intern, you will provide vital support to our producers and project managers while gaining hands-on experience in the industry. You will assist in coordinating shoots, managing equipment, and ensuring the logistical aspects are in place for successful project delivery. Your schedule will be flexible, meaning you can be on set one day and prepare another production the next day. This internship offers a great opportunity to learn and grow in a dynamic and creative environment.

About you

  • You are currently enrolled at a Dutch educational institute and based in the Netherlands.

  • You are available to start in September 2026 or earlier, for 4-5 days a week.

  • You speak and write English fluently. Being able to speak Dutch is useful.

  • You have a driving License B.

  • You have a passion for social media & creativity and want to make an impact.

  • You understand and respect our inclusive way of working.

  • You have great communication skills to fix and get things done.

  • You are eager to learn and develop yourself during your internship.

  • You know how to take initiative, like being actively involved, and understand the dedication needed for a production.


Apply for the internship

Do you want to join our team as our new Production Assistant Intern? Then we'd love to hear from you!

payload.title: Content Creative
payload.description:
At Home we're looking for a content creative that loves to create content for brands.

A bit about us

Home is a social-first creative agency. We make brands such as IKEA, Zalando, HelloFresh, and the Rookvrije Generatie relevant by creating work shaped by culture. This includes campaigns, content, creator or brand collaborations, and brand activations. While doing so, we strive to achieve our mission of creating a more inclusive tomorrow. This is because we believe that a more inclusive society is not only a better place for all but also an effective business strategy for brands, as inclusivity helps attract a wider audience.

About the job

We are looking for someone who comes with creative content ideas, while understanding what's happening in culture. You understand the clients needs and you are able to translate that into culturally relevant content. You know how to put your ideas into words and love to make this content come to life in the high pace of the internet.

About you

  • You are social native

  • You speak and write English and Dutch both fluently

  • You understand and respect the inclusive way of working

  • You have strong communication skills and an optimistic attitude

  • You have 3+ years of work experience as a content creative

  • You have the ability to surprise us and the creative team

  • You follow developments in content and advertising


Apply for the job

Eager to join the team as the new creative? Then we'd love to hear about you!

payload.title: Sales Executive - Amsterdam
payload.description:
Homerun is een hiring- en people platform, gemaakt voor moderne teams.

Ook wij zijn een klein bedrijf – in totaal maar 26 mensen. We doen dingen op onze eigen manier — of eigenlijk, op de manier waarvan wij denken dat die de juiste is.

  • Homerun ATS geeft teams de mogelijkheid om kandidaten bij te houden, sollicitaties samen te beoordelen, kandidaten op de hoogte te houden en interviews te plannen, allemaal vanuit één overzichtelijke app.

Homerun is enorm succesvol in Nederland en het is nu tijd om de rest van de wereld te laten weten dat we bestaan.


We zijn op zoek naar een Sales Executive om ons Commercial team te versterken en interesse om te zetten in klanten.



Je werkt samen met HR-teams van MKB bedrijven en begeleidt hen vanaf het allereerste gesprek totdat ze tevreden klanten zijn geworden. Je kansen komen voort uit een combinatie van inkomende leads en gerichte uitgaande benaderingen van onze ideale klanten, en een groot deel van je functie bestaat uit het voeren van doordachte, boeiende kennismakingsgesprekken en demo’s die teams helpen de juiste beslissing te nemen. Als belangrijk lid van het commerciële team speel je een cruciale rol bij het genereren van omzet en het omzetten van interesse in langdurige klantrelaties.
